scares.description: A zombie hand suddenly bursts out of the table.
As Carol Anne touches the mirror, a pair of hands phase out from the other side and grab her.
The phone makes a loud screeching noise, startling Dr. Seaton.
Zombified hands suddenly appear out of the puddle and drag Carol Anne down.
There is a sudden burst of light behind Bruce.
The animal meat hanging near the walls suddenly shriek and begin to move.
Reverend Kane appears in the elevator mirror behind Bruce and Patricia.
As Bruce lifts up a corpse, there is a sudden cut to its face as it makes a shrieking noise.
Patricia’s reflection quickly turns around to reveal it has a zombified face.
